methods: Derive a replacement interface lemma and price its implementation.

Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

actual_scope: Enforce a versioned simple-support scatter schema at opt-in checker and exporter entry points, with exact selected-word artifact identity and paired-duplicate rejection before output.
scope_change_reason: Revision 6 prefers concrete central handoffs. PR2977 establishes the duplicate-scatter cross-stage mismatch and requests successor schema enforcement; this is a bounded bit-interface reliability result rather than a new helper-mixing construction.
bottleneck_link: The bit supplier requires a sound source-to-record boundary. Shared simple-support validation makes occurrence XOR and membership lowering agree, without asserting that either replaces native columns or H1-H5.
stop_rule: One shared schema validator, two thin entry modes, exact selected baseline and paired-mutant controls, bounded schema enumeration, focused replay and review. No supplier search or adoption.
